M11 closure hardening 6 (implementer): CRASH-LINEARIZABLE MAINTENANCE LOCK — the verified-backup operation is an exported callable (runVerifiedBackup) invoked IN THE LOCK OWNER'S PROCESS: upgrade no longer spawns a backup child, so nothing capable of using the shared maintenance resources can survive the owner's death and overlap a new owner (the TENVYR_MAINTENANCE_TOKEN inheritance mechanism is entirely removed);
